pitch: B-flat +15 with slide closed; B-flat -15 with slide extended approx. 44mm.
remarks: 2 tubular slide stays, lower one telescopic; ferrules rather plain, with simple ring pattern; no saddle, no ring at slide bow; flat bumper guard at bottom of slide bow [restoration?]; 1 flat bell stay, hinge, pin, no eyelet; no saddle or ring in bell bow; new tubing in bell, rather like a tuning slide; patch in bell near stay; garland has floral-leaf pattern; Nuremberg-style rim wire with flat seam visible underneath; examined by the author, June 1999.
